name: Redline Rivals VR: Drag Racing
summary:
Feel the redline. Master the shift. Dominate the strip. This is Redline Rivals VR drag racing.
Grip the wheel, feel the engine roar, and master the one skill that separates champions from the rest: the perfect shift. Timing is everything — nail every manual gear change at the redline to launch off the line, trigger explosive speed boosts, and leave your rivals in the dust.
This isn't auto-shifting. Every gear is yours to command. Read the rev, feel the moment, shift with precision — one mistake and the race
